column2: A thousand kilograms; the exact weight at which a suitcase stops feeling merely 'heavy'.

Loud, heavy footsteps; the acoustic warning that an entire crowd is approaching.
A treacherous marshy bog where the ground pretends to be solid just to lure travellers in.
A large travelling bag or sack; luggage with zero ambition of ever appearing on a fashion runway.

A room for answering nature's call; the one destination on holiday that often outranks every local monument.

A native or citizen of Turkey; a word steeped in transcontinental geography and history.
A porous volcanic rock; stone born directly out of fire and ash.
Footwear enclosing the foot; a wardrobe item frequently purchased for a single evening and regretted by midnight.
A dark, brooding mass of cloud; the sky's polite hint that you ought to fetch an umbrella.
Cosmetic wand for eyelashes—or black ink for sketching; glamour and graphic design in a single word.
An evergreen conifer shrub; the dependable backbone of every neat suburban hedge.
A hefty orange gourd destined for autumn soups, pies, and mildly terrifying porch lanterns.
The area behind the front lines; the logistical zone where supplies, tea, and backup live.
A soft collapsible container for paste or cream; packaging you roll up with obsessive precision until the very last drop.
A sheer, gossamer curtain fabric; a way to dress a window without sentencing the room to darkness.
A member of the peoples speaking related Eurasian languages; a term spanning vast steppes and centuries.
A long-handled gardening blade for weeding; the gardener's trusty sidekick in the eternal war on dandelions.
A drop in numbers or quantity; a downward trend nobody ever cheers for on a payslip.

A large non-venomous snake that subdues prey with a squeeze; proof that not all hugs are well-intentioned.
Reckless, spirited bravado; the quality of someone who leaps flamboyantly first and consults logic later.
A sudden forceful impact; a brief event followed by a rather loud consequence.
A fortunate turn of events; when everything goes swimmingly despite your complete inability to explain why.
A crested bird with a long curved bill; a feathered dandy sporting a hairdo no barber could replicate.
Leather straps fitted to a horse's head; the diplomatic channel through which rider and steed negotiate.
A person held in confinement; someone whose freedom is currently available strictly by appointment.
An ornamental design of repeating motifs; decoration that thrives on order and symmetry.
A member of a Turkic people of Central Asia with their own language and rich cultural heritage.
An official order issued by a head of state; paperwork that politely declines to be optional.

An injection with a needle—or a sharp prick; a tiny medical procedure preceded by disproportionate dread.
An expression of disapproval; a single look capable of outperforming a twenty-minute lecture.
A feathery, aromatic herb; an essential guest in summer salads and pickled cucumbers.

An item or trace that helps crack a crime; a tiny detail that gives away a massive secret.
A public thoroughfare flanked by buildings; a city's open-air living room.
Haul of fish landed by an angler; the tangible dividend of staring patiently at water for hours.
A cheerful facial expression; a brief gesture that frequently accomplishes more than a lengthy explanation.
A natural brown earth pigment prized by painters for its calm, understated character.
Words or a glance conveying sharp displeasure; a verbal finger pointed squarely at the culprit.
A heavy radioactive element packed with the sort of energy that demands very serious supervision.

A period of instruction or a hard-won life experience; occasionally repeated until the penny finally drops.
A dried stone fruit; concentrated summer sunshine packed into a bite-sized snack.
A favourable outcome of hard work; the gratifying moment when effort finally earns applause.
A stepped projection on a cliff or wall; a natural or architectural shelf.
The tidal mouth where a river meets the sea; the grand finale of a freshwater journey.

Discarded material destined for recycling; belongings whose active career has officially concluded.

A heated household appliance; a persuasive, steaming argument against wrinkled shirts.

The organ of hearing; adept at detecting a crisp packet opening across the house - or collecting tall tales.
The pursuit of knowledge and skills; a marathon where the finish line keeps edging slightly further away.
A specialist devoted to research; someone who asks nature deeply inconvenient questions.
Careful registration and counting; the investigative art of discovering where the budget quietly vanished.
Tissue damage without broken skin; a colourful, unrequested souvenir from bumping into furniture.
A feeling of warmth and domestic comfort; achieved when a blanket, hot tea, and silence reach a truce.
Special goodwill or partiality; an advantage mysteriously distributed to everyone except you.
A low-pitched woodwind instrument; the orchestra's resident baritone with rather eccentric plumbing.
A colourful, long-tailed game bird; the feathered aristocrat of hedgerows and country estates.
A named collection of digital data; an electronic folder with a talent for vanishing right before a deadline.
A burning wooden brand; the original portable flashlight, completely free of battery anxiety.
A machine sending documents over phone lines; a nostalgic hello from when paper travelled by wire.
The hanging rear flap of a formal jacket; tailoring designed to give fabric a bit of theatrical sweep.
A front-mounted vehicle light; a car's eyes, particularly grateful for the invention of dusk.
A broad comedy packed with absurd situations; theatre where dignity is checked at the door.
Finely chopped meat; the humble foundation of burgers, pies, and heated debates over juiciness.
The principal front of a building; a house's public face—often considerably tidier than what lies behind it.
The tailored style or shape of a garment; what decides whether an outfit looks sharp or merely hopeful.

Inevitable destiny; a convenient literary scapegoat for improbable plot twists.
All the animal life of a region or era; the entire local menagerie, admission free.

The most agile piece on the chessboard; the board's reigning monarch who goes wherever she pleases.
A flat-topped conical red felt hat traditionally associated with Ottoman attire.
An object of excessive devotion; something wielding wildly disproportionate authority over one's attention.
A dense non-woven fabric of matted fibres; cloth made without a loom ever getting involved.
A mythical winged sprite capable of granting wishes and resolving sticky plotlines with one wand wave.

A prime boneless cut of meat or fish; the portion reserved for dinners you actually want to impress at.
A large nocturnal owl with prominent ear tufts; a woodland observer with a profoundly judgemental stare.
A motion picture; a story that whisks you into another world for two hours—popcorn optional.
The concluding part of a show or contest; the moment all loose plot threads are expected to behave.
The sweet fruit of a desert palm; nature's own toffee, minus the dentist's disapproval.
The end of a race; the painted line after which you are legally permitted to stop running.
Legendary jeweller of astronomically priced, enamelled trinkets—and the favourite plot MacGuffin of every Hollywood heist film.
A vengeful mythological deity—or, in everyday parlance, a woman whose patience has thoroughly expired.
The 1942 Hollywood classic blending wartime intrigue, romance, and three Academy Awards.
A Japanese pufferfish delicacy prized equally for its flavour and the thrilling gamble against tetrodotoxin.
Vital life force in Chinese philosophy; the original morning pick-me-up, entirely caffeine-free.
The exact headcount of Danny Ocean's stylish crew in the 2004 sequel - one more than Eleven, and one shy of Thirteen.
Notorious Renaissance dynasty, originally Spanish, famously Florentine and Roman, whose dinner invitations came with a side of political intrigue and suspected poison.
